authorization: Joseph 2026-08-23 diagnostic grant. PET remains diagnostic/method-development; nothing here reopens OI-126 or bears on coverage.

RULING_1_interior_barrier_blocks_CONFIRM.the_defect_was_mine: I specified the t grid so the path would be visible, then wrote a boundary that reads only its endpoints. CONFIRM's stated meaning is 'flat direction'; an interior barrier with near-coincident endpoints is a BARRIER BETWEEN TWO BASINS, a different object with arguably opposite implications.
RULING_1_interior_barrier_blocks_CONFIRM.new_branch: BARRIER (ENDPOINTS FLAT, PATH NOT) -- reported with max_t[L(t)-L(0)] and its ratio to |dL|
RULING_1_interior_barrier_blocks_CONFIRM.why_the_number_was_reused_not_chosen: 2.4e-3 is inherited from the existing predeclaration rather than selected after seeing data -- the least-tainted option once replica_49's midpoint was known

TAINT_CLAUSE_RESOLVED_AS_INERT.what_I_wrote: replica_49's BARRIER verdict is tainted by construction, hypothesis-generating only
TAINT_CLAUSE_RESOLVED_AS_INERT.what_the_executing_lane_established: BARRIER requires |dL| <= 2.4e-3 as a PRECONDITION. replica_49's |dL| = 5.199e-03 = 2.17x threshold, so it never reaches that branch. UNRESOLVED before the amendment and UNRESOLVED after. No verdict of replica_49 rests on the added criterion.
TAINT_CLAUSE_RESOLVED_AS_INERT.the_transferable_distinction: A MEASUREMENT is not tainted by when you looked at it; a VERDICT derived from it would be. The interior value stands as a reported quantity and as the amendment's motivating example. The five unseen members are the clean test.

WHAT_A_BARRIER_DOES_AND_DOES_NOT_REFUTE: REFUTES linear flatness on the measured segment
does NOT establish the OPPOSITE branch -- a barrier is not 'the members are loss-preferred'
does NOT refute a low-curvature direction locally at either solution: the mechanism's claim is about local curvature and a straight line in parameter space is not a path the fit ever traversed

MEANS the sweep is not measuring the quantity it was built to measure (curvature along the realized displacement) -- R4's class, an instrument that cannot answer its own question. An honest outcome and a real result, not a refutation.
RULING_1_interior_barrier_blocks_CONFIRM.background_NOT_leaned_on: nominal and members share initialization (set_random_seed(42)), the same 2M subsample and the same split, so these are not independently-trained networks. But NEITHER LANE has established the barrier scale for this architecture, so 'more informative than otherwise' is an open question, not support.

RULING_2_structural_arm_scope_EIGHTH_BOU.the_eighth_mode: a per-unit test whose reference is a POPULATION AGGREGATE, applied to a unit deliberately SELECTED for departing from that aggregate. The rule is well-formed, the sample is well-chosen, and they are incompatible.
RULING_2_structural_arm_scope_EIGHTH_BOU.how_it_arose: I wrote the structural arm's sign from the family loading (+0.10970 band, -0.03351 tail) and then approved a member list built to include the member least like the family.
RULING_2_structural_arm_scope_EIGHTH_BOU.ruling: report the arm BOTH ways per member -- family-derived sign as the PREDECLARED verdict, each member's own measured band/tail deviation signs alongside, divergences flagged. Aggregate over the FIVE family-pattern members; replica_49 reported separately.
RULING_2_structural_arm_scope_EIGHTH_BOU.exclusion_basis_is_PRE_SWEEP: replica_49's own deviations, band -0.1661 and tail -0.1893, signs (-,-) against the mode's (-,+), were known before the sweep and were the stated reason for its selection. Predeclarable-in-principle, not a post-hoc drop.
RULING_2_structural_arm_scope_EIGHTH_BOU.substantive_point: (-,-) is OFF-MODE, not a quiet version of the mode. A leading mode at 75.8% of variance necessarily leaves off-mode structure.
RULING_2_structural_arm_scope_EIGHTH_BOU.SHARED_ORIGIN_WARNING: R2's UNRESOLVED and replica_49's structural failure are THE SAME FACT SEEN TWICE and must be counted once.

RULING_3_my_OPPOSITE_LABEL_OVER_CLAIMED_.the_defect: I labelled the branch 'the members are loss-preferred and the NOMINAL is the outlier'. theta_k was trained to minimise objective_k, so L_k(theta_k) < L_k(theta_nom) is close to expected BY CONSTRUCTION. dL > 0 in SIGN is not evidence.
RULING_3_my_OPPOSITE_LABEL_OVER_CLAIMED_.what_IS_informative: the MAGNITUDE against the epoch-noise null, which is what the 2.4e-3 threshold tests. replica_00's dL = +2.648768e-02 = 11.04 thresholds, 42.95x its own sd -> theta_nom is genuinely DISTINGUISHABLE from theta_k under k's objective. That result stands.
RULING_3_my_OPPOSITE_LABEL_OVER_CLAIMED_.what_does_NOT_follow: 'the nominal is the outlier'. The test measured only one direction: L_k at both parameter points, never L_nom at both. If both penalties are large and comparable, neither point is an outlier -- two distinct solutions each better on its own data, the ordinary consequence of fitting perturbed data. ONLY AN ASYMMETRY singles one out.
RULING_3_my_OPPOSITE_LABEL_OVER_CLAIMED_.the_ninth_mode: a one-directional test used to support a claim that requires a comparison of two directions. The measurement cannot distinguish 'the nominal is special' from 'the two fits simply differ', and the latter is the null.
RULING_3_my_OPPOSITE_LABEL_OVER_CLAIMED_.binding_verdict_language: Until the reciprocal arm lands, replica_00's verdict line reads: theta_nom is distinguishable from theta_k under k's objective at 11 thresholds; whether the nominal is anomalous is NOT determined. 'The nominal is the outlier' may not appear anywhere, including in summaries.
RULING_3_my_OPPOSITE_LABEL_OVER_CLAIMED_.PATTERN_DEFLATED: 'both members have the same sign' is expected by construction and must NOT be carried as an emerging finding.

RECIPROCAL_ARM_PREDECLARED_BEFORE_IT_RUN.design: a separate short job AFTER the current sweep completes -- do not jeopardise the running job. Two extra evaluations per member: the NOMINAL's objective at theta_nom and theta_k. Same +/-1.3% bracket applied, since the nominal's own weights_pull carries the same provenance offset and cancels the same way.
RECIPROCAL_ARM_PREDECLARED_BEFORE_IT_RUN.TAINT_CLAUSE: dL_k is known for replica_00 (2.648768e-02) and replica_49 (5.198768e-03) -- two of six denominators. NO dL_nom is known for any member. Report A for those two with the taint noted; the four unseen members carry the evidential weight.

SHARED_ORIGINS_TO_COUNT_ONCE: R2's leading-mode loading and replica_00's structural PASS: one family-level loading plus one member-level realisation drawn from that same 50-member family. More than a restatement, less than two independent measurements. FLAGGED SYMMETRICALLY because this is the only CONFIRMING result of the day.
The iteration sweep's Q(2) reproducing R1's primary exactly is a deliberate cross-check, not a second result.
R3's '4:1 predicted, 4.05 measured' matched one of three available statistics for the same amplitude ratio (2.07 peak-to-trough, 4.05 unweighted sd, 4.77 mass-weighted).
max_over_min_is_STRUCTURALLY_SIGN_BLIND: Stronger than my original 'inflated by non-monotonicity': a ratio bounded below by 1 CANNOT express that the endpoint moved in the opposite direction. replica_00's band max/min is 5.4029 against an endpoint ratio of 0.2097. That is an instrument incapable of falsifying a directional hypothesis, not merely an inflated one. Endpoint-to-endpoint stays primary; report both with the endpoint DIRECTION stated.
